## Appendix

| Bizfuse Process Status Code   | Unnamed: 2                        | Unnamed: 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | HTTP Status Code                                                                                     |
|:------------------------------|:----------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Process status                | Message                           | description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Code                                                                                                 |
| 0                             | Successful completion             | An operation has completed normally, having met no exceptions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | 200 Success - server completed the request as expected                                               |
| 10004000                      | Bad Request                       | The ASP cannot and will not process the request due to an apparent client error (e.g. malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing) The request could not be understood by the server due to malformed syntax. The client SHOULD NOT repeat the request without modifications. | 400 Bad Request – client sent an invalid request, such as lacking required request body or parameter |
| 10004001                      | Unauthorized                      | The user authentication is required and has failed or has not yet been provided.                                                                                                                                                                                                            | 401 Unauthorized – client failed to authenticate with the server                                     |
| 10004003                      | Forbidden                         | The user does not have permission to access ASP web service.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | 403 Forbidden – client authenticated but does not have permission to access the requested resource   |
| 10004004                      | Not Found                         | The requested ASP web service could not be found but may be available again in the future. Subsequent requests by the client are permissible.                                                                                                                                               | 404 Not Found – the requested resource does not exist                                                |
| 10004029                      | Too Many Requests                 | The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time. Intended for use with rate limiting schemes.                                                                                                                                                                                 | 500 Internal Server Error – a generic error occurred on the server                                   |
| 10004400                      | BizFuse ASP Authorization Timeout | The client's session has expired and must log in again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | 503 Service Unavailable – the requested service is not available                                     |
| 10005000                      | BizFuse ASP Internal Server Error | A generic error message, given when an unexpected condition was encountered and no more specific message is suitable. The request could not be processed.                                                                                                                                   |                                                                                                      |
| 10005020                      | Bad Gateway                       | The server was acting as a gateway or proxy and received an invalid response from the upstream server.                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                      |
| 10005030                      | Service Unavailable               | The server is currently unavailable (because it is overloaded or down for maintenance)                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                      |
| 1000503x                      | *Custom System Level Error*       | The error mainly shows more specify to the customize system level error hits.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                                                                                                      |
| 10005040                      | Gateway Timeout                   | The ASP server was acting as a gateway or proxy and did not receive a timely response from the upstream server.                                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                                                      |
| 10006000                      | No Record Found                   | No record found from client request                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                      |
